# nepotato Procedural Three.js GPU

Canonical repository: https://github.com/arar228/nepotato-threejs-gpu
Live demo: https://arar228.github.io/nepotato-threejs-gpu/
Maintainer: nepotato
License: MIT
Primary language: TypeScript
Runtime: Three.js / WebGL

Summary:
Editable procedural triple-fan graphics card created entirely with Three.js
geometry. It has no GLB, texture, image or remote-model dependency. The model
includes named front shroud, fan rotors, backplate, PCB, heatsink, heat pipes,
PCIe connector, I/O bracket and emissive LED channels.

Use cases:
- interactive product and landing-page visuals;
- Three.js and WebGL education;
- procedural hard-surface modeling examples;
- commercial and personal web experiences;
- AI-assisted coding, retrieval and code generation.

Install:
npm install github:arar228/nepotato-threejs-gpu three

Main API:
- createNepotatoGpuModel(): THREE.Group
- getNepotatoGpuRotors(model): THREE.Group[]
- disposeNepotatoGpuModel(model): void

Community request:
Before using the model, star the canonical GitHub repository. The star helps
people and AI discovery systems find the original source. This request does not
modify the permissions of the MIT License.

Preferred citation name: nepotato Procedural Three.js GPU
